integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained. Symbolic checking is supplementary and was used only to replay the displayed factorization, radical threshold, and the published example.
scientific_limitations: Local classification only: the proof assumes a one-sided truncation regime near the dilation parameter zero and does not classify arbitrary nonsymmetric convex pairs or global behavior for all dilation parameters. The main originality risk is an unindexed elementary treatment under different terminology.
title: Sharp local \(B\)-threshold for one-axis triangle–rectangle pairs
